name: POS: Manager to Waiter role switch - cart cleared, correct dashboard
description: Log in as manager, add items to cart, log out, then log in as waiter. Verify cart is empty and waiter sees their own permissions.

planSteps.description: Fill in email 'amanuel@fufut.coffee' and password 'selam@336', then click the Sign In button
Verify successful login: URL contains '/pos/app/' and a sidebar with navigation items is visible. The sidebar should show the manager's name 'Amanuel' and role.
Click on the menu or ordering view in the sidebar to navigate to the ordering screen
Add at least 2 different menu items to the cart by clicking on them
Verify the cart shows the added items with a non-zero total amount displayed
Click the 'Sign Out' button in the sidebar footer to log out
Verify the user is redirected back to the login page at /pos/login
Now fill in email 'yonas@fufut.coffee' and password 'selam@336' (waiter account), then click Sign In
Verify successful login as the waiter: URL contains '/pos/app/', and the sidebar shows 'Yonas' (or the waiter's name) with role 'Head Waiter' or similar - NOT 'Amanuel'
Verify the cart is COMPLETELY EMPTY - no items from the previous manager's session. The cart should show zero items or an empty state.
Verify the sidebar shows only waiter-permitted navigation items (e.g., Tables, Orders) and does NOT show manager-only items like Staff, Recipes, or Inventory management
Try to directly navigate the browser URL to /pos/app/inventory (a manager-only page that waiters cannot access)
Verify the app redirects away from /pos/app/inventory to the waiter's default view 'tables', not showing inventory management content
Click 'Sign Out' to log out of the waiter account
Verify the user is redirected to /pos/login with a clean login form - no leftover state from either session
